name: Mythic Greater Disarm (Mythic)
source: Mythic Options: The Missing Core Feats
book: Mythic Options: The Missing Core Feats

facets.bk: Mythic Options: The Missing Core Feats

body:
You can disarm a foe with such precision as to place its weapons in the hands of allies.

Prerequisites: Combat Expertise, Greater Disarm, Improved Disarm, base attack bonus +6, Int 13.

Benefit(s): When you disarm a foe, as a free action you can choose to have the item you disarm be in your hand (if you have a free hand), in the hand of any ally within 15 feet who has a free hand, or tucked into a belt, bag, or haversack in your possession.
